_note: Furniture for the 3D rooms (docs/PLAN-M10.md), written by scripts/furniture.mjs: edit that and run it, not this. Metres. Each item's footprint (size: width x depth x height) is centred on x = 0, z = 0, with y = 0 the floor; its back is -z, against its wall, and its front +z faces into the room. Parts: s = box | cyl | sph; p = centre; z = size (box [x, y, z], cyl [diameter, height], sph [diameter]); c = a colour name, or 'accent' for the room's category colour; r = rotation in degrees [x, y, z]; glow = lights up at night. rooms lists what each room type may hold.
